checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging.
Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present.
Weathering is driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime.

PBR generation now includes physical-scale micro maps for infrastructure plus separate metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers for grass, paving and soil. Broad paving no longer relies on a painted joint grid; modeled joint geometry remains the construction source.
Solar direction/elevation context exists for coherent midsummer lighting.
Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art.
Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops now rebuilds and validates infrastructure microdetail and metric anti-repeat base-ground PBR before rendering.
Capture contract records exact view/crop paths and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it.
No actual Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection only. The substantive head has no commit status contexts or workflow runs, so Unity 6.3 compile/shader/material generation and native render execution remain unverified.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: broad primitive ground no longer uses a single arbitrary 0..1-scale material; each saved surface material derives macro/detail repeats from real renderer dimensions.
Material/PBR plausibility: grass, paving and compacted soil receive non-metallic two-frequency PBR with restrained roughness/normal ranges and material-cause variation rather than baked lighting.

Geometry/construction fidelity and anti-repetition: paving base maps intentionally omit painted joint grids so the existing physical 12 mm joint recess geometry remains the only joint source; world-phase offsets reduce visible texture resets between ground objects.
Temporal/aliasing stability: both macro and detail maps require mipmaps, trilinear filtering and anisotropy. Actual visual points remain unavailable until rendered motion/stills exist.
latestRun.nextBlocker: Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile and native 4K render evidence. If runtime remains unavailable next run, prioritize physical grass/soil/paving boundary and contact geometry rather than adding more scoring infrastructure.
